author: Madison Lim
title: Terra Nova, Hamilton, and the slow sinking of Lulu Island — how delta silt and salt air kill TorqueMaster springs in Richmond.
lede_excerpt: Richmond sits at an average elevation of one metre above sea level. The City of Richmond's own planning documents project about 200 mm of land subsidence by 2100 — the delta silt is settling, the Fraser is still depositing sediment, the water table is high year-round. Your house …
